note: How node scripts/rights.mjs resolve reads the rundown's federal .gov and Wayback steps, whose queries are prose. A pin is an item the rundown or the echo pick names, a federal RSS feed filtered to the step's window by a title pattern, a Wayback CDX search inside the window, or a probe of a host with no search the fetcher can read (its answer is the recorded reason). A pin never widens the allowlist: every address is checked against the fetcher's hosts. Nothing here is a rights decision; the fetcher checks every candidate.
